def test_first_generic_verse(self):
    expected = [
        "99 bottles of beer on the wall, 99 bottles of beer.",
        "Take one down and pass it around, 98 bottles of beer on the wall.",
    ]
    self.assertEqual(recite(99, 1), expected)

def test_last_generic_verse(self):
    expected = [
        "3 bottles of beer on the wall, 3 bottles of beer.",
        "Take one down and pass it around, 2 bottles of beer on the wall.",
    ]
    self.assertEqual(recite(3, 1), expected)

def test_verse_with_one_bottle(self):
    expected = [
        "1 bottle of beer on the wall, 1 bottle of beer.",
        "Take it down and pass it around, no more bottles of beer on the wall.",
    ]
    self.assertEqual(recite(1, 1), expected)

def test_song_with_no_bottles(self):
    expected = [
        "No more bottles of beer on the wall, no more bottles of beer.",
        "Go to the store and buy some more, 99 bottles of beer on the wall.",
    ]
    self.assertEqual(recite(0, 1), expected)

def test_first_two_verses(self):

        "98 bottles of beer on the wall, 98 bottles of beer.",
        "Take one down and pass it around, 97 bottles of beer on the wall.",
    ]
